title: Spawn Egg And Spawner Auth
description:
Only players in creative mode are allowed to use spawn eggs to modify monster spawners.
只允许创造模式下的玩家使用刷怪蛋修改刷怪笼
body:
This is a very simple module that only allows players in Creation Mode to use the Spawn Egg to modify the Spawner.

这是一个很简单的模组，只允许创造模式下的玩家使用刷怪蛋修改刷怪笼
